instruction: I'm using Ubuntu and need to set File Roller (Archive Manager) as my default application for compressed files. Could you configure this?

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting File Roller as default archive manager. Evaluator checks xdg-mime settings for common archive MIME types (zip, tar.gz, rar, etc.) to verify org.gnome.FileRoller.desktop is registered. Similar complexity to original VLC task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly queries xdg-mime for 8 common archive MIME types and returns the most common default app
Metric logic correctly uses check_include_exclude to verify File Roller is the default archive manager
Data flow is correct: getter returns string (app name), metric checks if it contains expected value
Complete coverage: evaluator checks default archive manager across multiple archive formats as required by instruction
Edge cases handled appropriately: returns 'unknown' if no defaults set, uses most_common to aggregate across MIME types
Expected value is semantically correct: org.gnome.FileRoller.desktop is the correct .desktop file for File Roller
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The getter checks 8 specific archive MIME types which covers common cases, but some exotic archive formats might be missed. This is acceptable for practical purposes.
